description: Mechanical cross-check of central_bridge_triangle_final.md Part X.0: exhaustively over all 4 rows of central_bridge_triangle.md Part V.1's (X_x,X_y) table, the two admissible-pair terminal sets {x,X_x} and {y,X_y} always either coincide or share exactly one element -- a genuinely 4-distinct-terminal 'crossing' configuration never occurs, since both sets are 2-subsets of the single 3-element triangle T.
